title: ClearPath Renewal Rates and Service Credits Received
content:
**Rule.** The service-level adjustment of the renewal rate on an automatic renewal of a ClearPath Managed IT Services agreement counts the service credits posted on the agreement in the last 12 months (a month window ending today):
- 3 or more service credits take 1.5 percent off the renewal rate;
- one up to 2 service credits take 0.75 percent off;
- none takes nothing off.

A whole month between two dates is counted only once the later date reaches the same day of the month as the earlier one, and a month window of N months ending today takes the entries dated fewer than N whole months before today. The credits counted are the service credit entries on the agreement's billing ledger, by their posting date.

**Questions this rule answers.**

*Does a service credit posted exactly 12 months before today count?* No. On 2025-06-15 a credit posted 2024-06-15 is 12 whole months old and falls outside the window; one posted 2024-06-16 is fewer than 12 whole months old and counts.

*Two credits in the window?* 0.75 percent off the renewal rate.

*Five credits?* 1.5 percent off; the percentage does not grow beyond that.

*No credit in the window, but several earlier?* Nothing is taken off.
